title: Choose which tame is the mount (Pack > Party > Ride)
steps: isle=reef, stable Tusktop t1, Fern Raptor t2, Stegolith t3, Tidesteed t4, saddles in pack
Pack > Party: tap Ride on Tidey
expected: Tidesteed becomes the mount and is drawn with its own saddle
actual: tames.mount = t4, R rides tidesteed (drawn tidesteed_idle_right + tidesteed_saddle). Cycled Ride on t1, t3, t4 in turn: each one ridden and drawn correctly, 3 mounts on both 1280x720 and 390x844. Choice persists after reload (mountId t4). Ride buttons are 44 px

title: Stable list with Join party / Rest / Ride per tame
expected: Whole stable listed with toggles, persists
actual: All 4 tames listed with level and state; Rest/Join/Ride buttons 44 px high. Rest t2 then Join t3 works, party [t1,t3], live companions match, both survive reload. Third Join while party is 2 is disabled (title 'Party is full (2). Rest one first.'). All buttons disable with 'Get off your mount first (R).' while riding. Esc closes the panel. No release/rename yet (not required by the row)

title: Companions in attack mode no longer hurt the soothe target
steps: spawn stegolith (and fernraptor) 4 tiles away, Soothe on, shoot until KO
expected: Same HP loss with attack and follow
actual: stegolith attack: 400 -> 146.5, KO after 39 shots; follow: identical 146.5. Fern Raptor target: 85 -> 59 in both modes, KO after 4 shots, never vanished. Companions (pink hearts) stand by while it sleeps

title: Reload keeps picked glints and the pouch
steps: fresh save, ?test=1, walk over all 93 nodes (wood 35, berries 39)
expected: Glints stay spent, pouch not refilled
actual: Before reload 0 of 93 ready, after reload 0 of 93 ready, inventory and pouch identical (berry 12 / meat 12 / bug 8, no refill)

title: Oakback still needs golden apples; home has 1 golden-apple glint (900 s)
expected: Reachable food supply for the XL rare
actual: foodFor('oakback') = golden_apple; foodGlints has exactly one golden_apple (respawn 900); pouch is clover 10 / apple 4 (no golden apple). Unchanged. With the new node persistence (b05-04 fixed) the reload shortcut is gone, so the 12-apple tame is now truly about 3 hours of respawns. Said to be part of G-26 economy (not landed)

title: Double click on Craft now makes one saddle
steps: Pack > Craft, real mouse double click on Stegolith saddle
actual: One saddle (hide 9 -> 6, saddle_stegolith 1). The row title shows '(have N)'. Note: the raw API I.craft() called twice in a row still crafts twice (saddle x2 in an earlier run), so the guard is in the UI path only; harmless for players

title: Gather with a full pack keeps the spot (code read)
actual: isles.js:1934 now checks invRoomFor(kind) before HS.gather and toasts 'Pack full. The spot keeps its find for later.' I could not fill 64 real stacks via give() (unknown ids are rejected), so this is a code read, not a play repro

title: Feed toast still one tick behind the button; Soothe label unchanged
steps: phone, KO Fern Raptor, toggle Soothe off, tap Feed 4 times at 600 ms
actual: Toasts: 'Normal shots.' then 'still chewing: ready in 6 s' while button says 'Chewing 5s', 'ready in 5 s' vs 'Chewing 4s', 'ready in 4 s' vs 'Chewing 4s'. Soothe button text stays 'Soothe' (aria-pressed false). Same as round 1

title: Log still has a gap: 'Nothing gathered yet. Look   for sparkles.'
actual: Visible blank of about 14 px between 'Look' and 'for sparkles.' (DOM text is continuous so an inline icon span renders empty)

title: How-to card: desktop OK now, phone card still covers the HUD and a toast sits on top of toast
steps: 390x844, tap Ride in the first seconds
actual: Desktop FIXED: card moved to the bottom-left, hero visible (a long hint toast still runs behind the card). Phone: the card covers the Tame/XP row of the HUD, 'Riding Tuskie. R to get off.' is stacked on top of a longer hint toast and both are unreadable; HUD name still wraps/truncates ('Verdant Jungle - beach', 'Tame...')

title: 5+ Canvas2D getImageData readback warnings per load persist
steps: load the Isles page on phone viewport, log console warnings
actual: 10 'Multiple readback operations using getImageData' warnings logged in the phone run (the desktop run was not checked). Unchanged

title: Desktop stable row text is clipped under the buttons: state suffix ', mount' / mode lost
steps: 1280x720, stable with a mounted tame in the party
expected: Whole label 'Tuskie (Tusktop) Lv 4 - attack, mount' readable
actual: Rows show 'Tuskie (Tusktop) Lv 4 - attack' with the Rest/Ride buttons right-aligned over the end of the label; for a resting mount the text ends at 'resting, mount' then wraps the Mount button to its own line. On phone the buttons wrap below the label (readable). Row layout is uneven (buttons on different lines per row)
